professionalSummary.text: Runs the cross-team programme plan for migrating internal services to the new orchestration platform
professionalSummary.witness: Technical program manager at Strata Ledger (accounting software), September 2021 to present, running the plan for moving 120 internal services from the legacy job scheduler to the new orchestration platform in six waves.

professionalSummary.text: Maintains the programme's risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies (RAID) log
professionalSummary.witness: Kept the programme RAID log, reviewing open risks and dependencies with the service owners every Tuesday and closing items only once the owning team had confirmed them.

professionalSummary.text: Coordinates migration readiness reviews with service owners, security and support
professionalSummary.witness: Ran readiness reviews for each migration wave with the service owners, the security team and customer support, using a checklist that covered rollback, alerting and support handover.

professionalSummary.text: Publishes a weekly programme status report
professionalSummary.witness: Published the weekly programme status report (waves completed, services blocked, top risks) to the engineering directors' mailing list, with a short section on any wave whose date had moved since the previous week.

experienceHighlights.text: Led migration of 120 internal services from legacy job scheduler to new orchestration platform in six waves
experienceHighlights.witness: Technical program manager at Strata Ledger (accounting software), September 2021 to present, running the plan for moving 120 internal services from the legacy job scheduler to the new orchestration platform in six waves.

experienceHighlights.text: Reviewed RAID log with service owners every Tuesday, closing items only after team confirmation
experienceHighlights.witness: Kept the programme RAID log, reviewing open risks and dependencies with the service owners every Tuesday and closing items only once the owning team had confirmed them.

experienceHighlights.text: Conducted readiness reviews using a checklist covering rollback, alerting and support handover
experienceHighlights.witness: Ran readiness reviews for each migration wave with the service owners, the security team and customer support, using a checklist that covered rollback, alerting and support handover.

experienceHighlights.text: Published weekly status report to engineering directors' mailing list with wave status updates
experienceHighlights.witness: Published the weekly programme status report (waves completed, services blocked, top risks) to the engineering directors' mailing list, with a short section on any wave whose date had moved since the previous week.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Readiness checklist for migration wave 4 completed for 18 services with rollback test results, alert ownership and support sign-off
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the readiness checklist used for migration wave 4, completed for 18 services, with the rollback test result, alert ownership and support sign-off recorded for each service.

skills.text: Executive presence trusted by senior stakeholders
skills.witness: Calm, inspiring presence in any crisis, with the kind of executive presence that senior stakeholders instinctively trust.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's role in running the migration plan, maintaining RAID, coordinating readiness reviews, and publishing status reports. They do not establish the candidate's ability to represent the programme to senior leadership or handle director-level escalations, as the reference note only confirms running the plan and RAID log, and the CV mentions executive presence but not specific leadership representation.
